name: English Opening
description: 1.c4, Nc3, g3 and Bg2: a flexible, positional set-up that works against almost everything.

lines.name: Reversed Dragon (3…d5)

notes.0: c4 controls d5 from the side; White builds slowly and keeps options open.
notes.4: g3 prepares Bg2, the key piece in the English.
notes.8: Bg2: the bishop hits the d5 knight along the long diagonal.
notes.12: O-O: a Sicilian Dragon with colours reversed and an extra move for White.

6.Bg2: …d4! hits the c3 knight and grabs space.

lines.summary: Against 1…e5 and …d5, take on d5, fianchetto and castle: a Dragon with an extra tempo.

lines.name: Reversed Dragon: 5…Nxc3

notes.0: c4 controls d5 from the side; White builds slowly and keeps options open.
notes.4: g3 prepares Bg2, the key piece in the English.
notes.8: Bg2: the bishop hits the d5 knight along the long diagonal.
notes.10: bxc3 strengthens the centre and opens the b-file for a rook.

6.Bg2: …d4! hits the c3 knight and grabs space.

lines.summary: When Black trades on c3, take back towards the centre and use the open b-file.

lines.name: Reversed Dragon: 5…Be6

notes.0: c4 controls d5 from the side; White builds slowly and keeps options open.
notes.4: g3 prepares Bg2, the key piece in the English.
notes.8: Bg2: the bishop hits the d5 knight along the long diagonal.

6.Bg2: …d4! hits the c3 knight and grabs space.

lines.summary: Against …Be6, develop Nf3 and castle; the e5 pawn is a target.

lines.name: 1…e5 3…Bc5

notes.0: c4 controls d5 from the side; White builds slowly and keeps options open.
notes.4: g3 prepares Bg2, the key piece in the English.

lines.summary: Against …Bc5, fianchetto, then Nf3 or e3 and castle.

lines.name: 1…e5 3…Bb4

notes.0: c4 controls d5 from the side; White builds slowly and keeps options open.
notes.4: g3 prepares Bg2, the key piece in the English.
notes.8: Nf3 develops; if …e4, the knight goes to d4.

lines.summary: Against …Bb4, fianchetto and develop Nf3; the c3 knight can be taken but White gets the bishop pair.

lines.name: 1…e5 3…Bb4 4…Bxc3

notes.0: c4 controls d5 from the side; White builds slowly and keeps options open.
notes.4: g3 prepares Bg2, the key piece in the English.
notes.8: bxc3 takes back towards the centre; White keeps the two bishops.

lines.summary: When Black gives up the bishop on c3, take back with the b-pawn and enjoy the bishop pair.

lines.name: 1…e5 2…Nc6

notes.0: c4 controls d5 from the side; White builds slowly and keeps options open.
notes.6: Bg2: the same fianchetto set-up against 2…Nc6.

lines.summary: Against 2…Nc6, the plan doesn't change: g3, Bg2, then Nf3 or e3.

lines.name: 1…e5 2…Nc6 4…Bc5

notes.0: c4 controls d5 from the side; White builds slowly and keeps options open.
notes.6: Bg2: the same fianchetto set-up against 2…Nc6.

lines.summary: Against …Bc5, develop with Nf3 (or e3 to blunt the bishop) and castle.

lines.name: 1…e5 2…Nc6 4…Bb4

notes.0: c4 controls d5 from the side; White builds slowly and keeps options open.
notes.6: Bg2: the same fianchetto set-up against 2…Nc6.
notes.8: Nd5 attacks the b4 bishop and takes the key d5 square.

lines.summary: Against …Bb4, jump into d5 with the knight: it hits the bishop and controls the centre.

lines.name: 1…Nf6 2…g6

notes.0: c4 controls d5 from the side; White builds slowly and keeps options open.
notes.6: Bg2: the fianchetto bishop presses on d5 and the long diagonal.
notes.10: O-O: a calm set-up; d4 or d3 and e4 come later.

lines.summary: Against the King's Indian set-up, fianchetto too: g3, Bg2, Nf3 and castle.

lines.name: 1…Nf6 2…e6

notes.0: c4 controls d5 from the side; White builds slowly and keeps options open.
notes.4: Nf3 keeps the options open; against …d5, White takes on d5.
notes.6: cxd5 gives the same pawn structure as your Queen's Gambit Exchange.

lines.summary: Against …e6 and …d5, develop Nf3 and take on d5: a Queen's Gambit Exchange structure.

lines.name: Symmetrical (1…c5)

notes.0: c4 controls d5 from the side; White builds slowly and keeps options open.
notes.8: Nf3 develops; O-O, d3 or a3 and b4 follow.

lines.summary: In the symmetrical English, fianchetto, castle, and play on the queenside with a3, Rb1 and b4.

lines.name: 1…e6

notes.0: c4 controls d5 from the side; White builds slowly and keeps options open.
notes.4: d4: the game becomes a Queen's Gambit Declined.

lines.summary: Against 1…e6 and …d5, d4 turns it into a Queen's Gambit Declined.
